**sdd/issue-802-teardown-sweep/apply-progress**

**What**: Issue #802 — converted every group-A recursive `rmSync(dir, {recursive:true,force:true})` teardown call site (30 files, 31 counting the already-safe test/review-regulated/fixture.mjs which needed nothing) to `removeTempTree` from `brain/scripts/__fixtures__/tmp-tree.mjs` (#801/#800). Added a drift-guard test `brain/scripts/__fixtures__/tmp-tree-adoption.test.mjs` (9 new tests) that scans brain/scripts/** and test/** for any .mjs file that BOTH spawns git (execFileSync/spawnSync('git',...) or a local git() helper) AND calls a recursive rmSync outside removeTempTree, failing and naming the offender with an actionable message. Branch: refactor/issue-802-refactortest-thirty-teardowns-share-the, repo /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-802 (worktree). NOT committed/pushed per instructions.

**Why**: #801 built removeTempTree but only converted one call site. #802's own survey found 31 files (143 occurrences) that spawn git into a directory they later rmSync — the actual race class from #800 (ENOTEMPTY/EBUSY from a concurrent git process). The other 68 files with rmSync-but-no-git-spawn (group C, ~314 occurrences) are correctly out of scope — no race possible there.

**Where**:
- Converted (all verified per-site that `dir` is genuinely mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(),...))-based before converting, per instructions):
  brain/scripts/brain-audit.test.mjs (37 sites), brain-promote.amendment.test.mjs (3), brain-promote.golden.test.mjs (10), brain-protect-server.test.mjs (3), harness/backends/antigravity.drift.test.mjs (2), bootstrap.worktree.test.mjs (1), governance/postmerge/cursor.test.mjs (6), brain-metrics.test.mjs (10), governance/postmerge/resolution.test.mjs (1), governance/postmerge/git-seam.test.mjs (7), review/cold-boot.mjs (1, PRODUCTION code — clears a stale worktree before `git worktree add`), review/cold-boot.test.mjs (4, kept the `git worktree prune` try/catch pre-step), lib/ticket-branch.test.mjs (1), review/evaluators/checkpoint.test.mjs (8, kept prune pre-step x4), review/lib/run-cold-review-stage.test.mjs (2), test/bootstrap-smoke/smoke.mjs (1), check-refs.test.mjs (11), hooks/hooks.attribution-parity.test.mjs (2), brain-metrics-audit-parity.test.mjs (1), lib/merge-walk.test.mjs (5), hooks/pre-receive.test.mjs (6), memory/lib/split-records.test.mjs (2), memory/lib/records-merge.integration.test.mjs (1), memory/lib/records-merge-duplicate.integration.test.mjs (1), memory/lib/resolve-index.integration.test.mjs (3), memory/cli.upstream-config.test.mjs (2), memory/lib/upstream-records.integration.test.mjs (1 loop of 3), memory/staged-records-check.integration.test.mjs (1 loop of 3), memory/backends/engram.branch.test.mjs (2), memory/backends/engram.mjs (2, PRODUCTION code — scratch dirs for engram export/import payloads).
- New file: brain/scripts/__fixtures__/tmp-tree-adoption.test.mjs (drift guard, 226 lines).
- NOT converted (left as-is, correctly out of scope — none needed an allowlist entry because none are recursive+git-adjacent):
  - brain-promote.amendment.test.mjs:578 `rmSync(wfg)` — single-file removal (no `recursive:true`), removes a file to symlink over it.
  - bootstrap.worktree.test.mjs:133 `rmSync(join(main,'.env'))` — single-file removal.
  - test/bootstrap-smoke/smoke.mjs:220 `rmSync(join(consumer,f), {force:true})` — single-file removal (no recursive).
  - test/review-regulated/fixture.mjs — listed in the original 31-file survey but has ZERO rmSync call (only a doc comment mentioning `rmSync`); the real call site (regulated-review.e2e.test.mjs) was already converted in #801.

**Learned**:
- `cold-boot.mjs` and `engram.mjs` are PRODUCTION (non-test) files with the exact same git-race shape (spawn git into a temp/worktree dir, then rmSync it) — converted them too since the ticket's own scope description names both files explicitly. This means production code now imports from a `__fixtures__/`-named directory; checked there's no packaging exclusion (`package.json` "files" ships all of `brain/scripts` wholesale) and no lint rule against it (only an unrelated agent-identity-agnostic.test.mjs exemption for that path pattern) — flagged as a minor naming-convention smell worth a future rename (`__fixtures__` reads test-only) but not a functional risk.
- Converting cold-boot.mjs's site changes failure-mode nuance: previously a failed rmSync would throw and abort `defaultCloneDetached`; now `removeTempTree` never throws (logs via `onLeak` to stderr) and the subsequent `git worktree add` will fail on its own with a directory-exists error instead — still fails loudly, just via a different message.
- The `[^)]*` regex naively used in sdd-layout.test.mjs's precedent breaks on nested-paren first args like `rmSync(join(main, '.env'))` — the drift guard uses a bounded-window scan (200 chars after each `rmSync(`, stopped at the next `rmSync(` call) instead, to avoid both that false-negative and misattributing a later call's `recursive: true` to an earlier one.
- Diff size: 31 files changed, 424 insertions / 169 deletions = 593 changed lines total — well under the 1000-line tier budget for this ticket.
- Full suite: 4497 pass / 0 fail (baseline 4488 + 9 new drift-guard tests). `npm run repo:check` and `npm run brain:nav` both clean.
